items.q: Will it actually sound like me?
items.a: Yes. Linka trains on your existing posts, bio, and writing samples you provide at setup. Most users edit fewer than 3 words per draft.
LinkedIn, Instagram (feed, reels, carousels), X, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Pages.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Connect once via OAuth and posts publish through official APIs — full auto-publish, no browser extension, no manual steps.

items.q: What if I don't like a draft?
items.a: Regenerate it, edit it inline, or skip it entirely. The model improves with every approve and reject over time.
Yes — one click from billing. You keep access until the end of the period and your data stays exportable for 30 days after.
